name: express-k6-profiler
description: A drop-in dashboard to profile Express bottlenecks, middlewares, and database queries during k6 load testing.

scripts.build:ui: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SVR,UI " "npm --prefix ui run dev" "cross-env __AS_DEV=true nodemon example/server.ts"
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && tsc && cp ui/dist/index.html dist/index.html
